   1 class_name BossSystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 
   5 func setup() -> void:
   6 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
   7 
   8 func query() -> QueryBuilder:
   9 	return q.with_all([C_Boss, C_Health, C_Transform]).enabled()
  10 
  11 func process(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, delta: float) -> void:
  12 	for entity in entities:
  13 		if not entity.enabled:
  14 			continue
  15 		var boss: C_Boss = entity.get_component(C_Boss)
  16 		var health: C_Health = entity.get_component(C_Health)
  17 		var combat: C_Combat = entity.get_component(C_Combat)
  18 		boss.arena_active = runtime.session.mode == "playing" and runtime.session.room_id == "house_throne" and entity.get_component(C_RoomMember).room_id == "house_throne" and not health.dead
  19 		if not boss.arena_active:
  20 			combat.requested_attack = ""
  21 			continue
  22 		var motion: C_Motion = entity.get_component(C_Motion)
  23 		var player_position: Vector2 = runtime.player.get_component(C_Transform).position
  24 		var position: Vector2 = entity.get_component(C_Transform).position
  25 		motion.facing = -1 if player_position.x < position.x else 1
  26 		if health.current <= health.maximum / 2 and not boss.phase_changed:
  27 			boss.phase = 2
  28 			boss.phase_changed = true
  29 			boss.state = "phase_change"
  30 			boss.time_left = 1.4
  31 			combat.state = "idle"
  32 			combat.requested_attack = ""
  33 			runtime.discard_transients()
  34 			runtime.session.message = "第二阶段 · 绯月狂宴"
  35 			for background in runtime.world.query.with_all([C_Visual, C_RoomMember]).enabled().execute():
  36 				if background.enabled and background.get_component(C_Visual).asset_id == "bg_throne":
  37 					background.get_component(C_Visual).tint = Color(0.88, 0.38, 0.66, 1.0)
  38 			_warning(entity, "phase_warning", position + Vector2(0, -145), Vector2(380, 290), 1.4)
  39 			continue
  40 		boss.time_left = maxf(0.0, boss.time_left - delta)
  41 		if boss.time_left > 0.0:
  42 			continue
  43 		match boss.state:
  44 			"idle", "recovery", "phase_change":
  45 				if boss.phase == 2 and boss.attack_index % 3 == 2:
  46 					_begin_slam(entity, player_position)
  47 				elif boss.attack_index % 2 == 0:
  48 					boss.state = "fan_warning"
  49 					boss.time_left = 0.65 if boss.phase == 1 else 0.55
  50 					_warning(entity, "fan_warning", position + Vector2(0, -100), Vector2(220, 140), boss.time_left + 0.35)
  51 				else:
  52 					_begin_slam(entity, player_position)
  53 			"fan_warning":
  54 				combat.requested_attack = "boss_fan"
  55 				boss.state = "fan_attack"
  56 				boss.time_left = 0.75
  57 			"slam_warning":
  58 				combat.requested_attack = "boss_slam"
  59 				boss.state = "slam_attack"
  60 				boss.time_left = 0.75
  61 			"fan_attack":
  62 				if boss.phase == 2:
  63 					_begin_slam(entity, player_position)
  64 				else:
  65 					_recover(boss)
  66 			"slam_attack":
  67 				_recover(boss)
  68 
  69 func _recover(boss: C_Boss) -> void:
  70 	boss.state = "recovery"
  71 	boss.time_left = 2.0 if boss.phase == 1 else 1.45
  72 	boss.attack_index += 1
  73 
  74 func _begin_slam(entity: Entity, target: Vector2) -> void:
  75 	var boss: C_Boss = entity.get_component(C_Boss)
  76 	boss.slam_center = Vector2(clampf(target.x, 120.0, 1480.0), 592.0)
  77 	boss.state = "slam_warning"
  78 	boss.time_left = 0.90 if boss.phase == 1 else 0.75
  79 	_warning(entity, "slam_warning", boss.slam_center, Vector2(220, 56), boss.time_left + 0.35)
  80 	runtime.request_spawn("effect", "house_throne", {"position": boss.slam_center + Vector2(0, -215), "kind": "ghost_hand", "duration": boss.time_left + 0.65, "size": Vector2(180, 240), "color": Color(0.8, 0.68, 1.0, 0.9), "owner_id": entity.id})
  81 
  82 func _warning(entity: Entity, kind: String, position: Vector2, size: Vector2, duration: float) -> void:
  83 	runtime.request_spawn("effect", "house_throne", {"position": position, "kind": kind, "duration": duration, "size": size, "color": Color(1.0, 0.48, 0.68, 1.0) if kind != "phase_warning" else Color(0.7, 0.4, 1.0, 1.0), "owner_id": entity.id})
